title: Point of Sale
subtitle: POS set-up for {company}: terminals, staff, tables, products and sales.

notInPlan.title: The Point of Sale is not included in your plan
notInPlan.body: You can prepare the set-up, but terminals only sell on a plan with POS. Contact ISPC Fácil to activate it.

grace: The subscription has expired. The POS keeps selling until {date}; renew the plan to avoid stopping.

general.businessTypeHint: In a restaurant the POS opens on the tables, sends orders to the kitchen/bar and lets you split the bill.
general.documentHint: The POS always issues an invoice-receipt (FR), to the walk-in customer or to a customer with a NUIT. Company under ISPC: no VAT.
general.receiptHeader: Extra line in the receipt header
general.receiptFooter: Message at the end of the receipt
general.mobileSimulated: Testing phase: M-Pesa and e-Mola are simulated (Sislog integration coming soon).
general.toleranceHint: Above this amount, closing the till needs a reason and a manager PIN.
general.blindCloseHint: The cashier counts the cash without seeing the expected amount.
general.mobileTimeout: Time for the customer to confirm M-Pesa/e-Mola (seconds)

terminals.step1: On the device (ABS, tablet, phone or PC), open
terminals.step3: Staff sign in with their PIN.
terminals.newPlaceholder: Terminal name (e.g. Till 1, Bar, Fátima's phone)
terminals.empty: There are no terminals yet. Create one for each device that will sell.
terminals.name: Terminal
terminals.revokeMessage: The device stops being able to sell immediately. This cannot be undone: to use it again, create a new terminal.

staff.name: Name
staff.rolesHint: Cashier: sells and opens/closes the till. Waiter: opens tables and sends orders. Manager: everything, and authorises discounts, cancellations, returns and till differences with their PIN.
staff.pinHint: 4 digits, different from other staff. Only the person should know it.
staff.hint: POS staff do not need an e-mail: they sign in on the terminal with their PIN.

tables.empty: Create an area (Dining room, Terrace, Bar…) and then the tables.
tables.removeZoneMessage: The tables in this area will have no area.

products.hint: Changes are saved immediately. Terminals see them when they refresh the catalogue.
products.empty: No products. Create them under Products & Services.
